svg.title: Max AI — one measured change at a time
svg.desc: Five steps in order: Notice, Decide, Ask, Verify, Remember. Max AI changes one thing at a time, only when the readings say so, and it keeps a record of what the device actually did afterwards.

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Inter, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
-apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Inter, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One measured change at a time — never a stack of tweaks.

svg.text: Why it is not a preset

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Inter, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A preset applies the same numbers to every device.

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Inter, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Max AI asks what this device is doing now, changes one thing,

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Inter, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: then measures whether it actually helped.
